podcast.title: Headliner at Sex Pistols' First Gig (November 6, 1975)
podcast.body: Vasuka Jo, featuring singer Adam Ant, was the headlining act at St. Martin's art school in London on November 6, 1975, when the Sex Pistols played their notoriously short first live gig as an opening act. "They were all there to see the headliners, group called Vasuka Jo that featured a singer by the name of Adam Ant."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Headlining Act at St. Martins (November 6, 1975)
podcast.body: This group, featuring singer Adam Ant, was the intended main act at St. Martins art school in London on the night the Sex Pistols made their chaotic debut as an opening act. "They were all there to see the headliners, group called Bizzouca Joe that featured a singer by the name of Adam Ant."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Very First Episode of the Ongoing History of New Music
